title: core: audit_logger_non_blocking test is timing-racy
description: The test drops AuditLoggerHandle then sleeps 300ms before checking event count. On a loaded machine the logger may not have flushed all events in 300ms — observed failure: 103/200 events stored. Root cause: tokio::spawn JoinHandle is discarded so there's no way to await logger completion. Fix: store JoinHandle in AuditLoggerHandle, add async shutdown() method, use it in the test instead of sleep.
